versions.changelog:
- Updated documentation, including significant content additions and refinements in all SKILL.md files.
- Major rewrite and expansion of the main suite overview in skills/super-dev-suite/SKILL.md.
- Improved clarity and detail for each child skill’s role and workflow.
- Enhanced instructions for initialization and activation.
- No functional changes to code; this update focuses on documentation and usability improvements.

- Initial release of Super-Dev Suite: a self-evolving, full-stack development toolkit.
- Features layered memory system, supply-chain security gatekeeping, and agent-driven workflow orchestration.
- Includes structured requirements analysis, TDD, sensory-level UI/UX audits, and automatic skill evolution across 9 modular roles.
- Deeply integrates key principles from agent-skills (e.g., test pyramid, audit patterns), plus unique abilities like independent UX audit and supply chain security.
- Easy bootstrap script provided; full compatibility with agent-skills.
